lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the branchial region, organized into approximately five primary horizontal rows extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the dorsal-lateral interface, defined by a sharp luminance transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The lateral surface of the first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 6-10 discernible high-intensity blobs, irregularly distributed within the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency, small-diameter stippling pattern on the cephalic region, transitioning to a lower-frequency, larger-diameter spot-and-stripe matrix posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
